trajectory_summary: The call opens cold, curdles into open hostility over redundant qualifying questions, and ends in a hard DQ once the ground-mount requirement surfaces. The rep never regains control — no probe on the prior quote, no cushioning of the swearing, and the roof/mount gate is delivered flatly with no bridge or alternative before the customer exits.
outcome_dispute: This is a legitimate DQ (ground-mount only, Ion residential-roof-only) rather than a rep failure to close, but the rep's flat delivery at 02:08 gave the customer no reason to stay on the line even a moment longer.
